---
title: Install, update, and remove Sentinel
---

Install Sentinel in each agent you use; each agent manages its own copy.

Before you start, ensure `uv`, `jq`, and `perl` are available (see [prerequisites](../index.qmd#prerequisites)).

Run these commands in your own terminal, not through an agent.
Sentinel defends its own install and settings, so it asks you or refuses when an agent tries to change them.

## Claude Code

To install, run:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add ahgraber/sentinel-hooks
claude plugin install sentinel@sentinel-hooks
```

Then start a new session.

To update, run `claude plugin update sentinel@sentinel-hooks`.
You can also open `/plugin`, select the `sentinel-hooks` marketplace on the **Marketplaces** tab, and choose **Update marketplace**.

To remove, run `claude plugin uninstall sentinel@sentinel-hooks`.

## Codex

Codex does not run hooks from plugins in the standard plugin format, which Sentinel uses ([openai/codex#47925](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/47925)).
A second step therefore writes Sentinel's hooks into your Codex hook file.

To install:

1. Add the marketplace:

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace add ahgraber/sentinel-hooks
    ```

2. Start Codex, open `/plugins`, and install Sentinel.

3. Run the hook installer from the installed copy:

    ```sh
    ~/.codex/plugins/cache/sentinel-hooks/sentinel/*/harnesses/codex/install-hooks.py
    ```

    If you set `CODEX_HOME`, replace `~/.codex` with its value.
    The installer keeps the other hooks in your hook file.

4. Start Codex, open `/hooks`, and trust Sentinel's hooks.

The hook file names the installed copy of Sentinel by its version.
After each update, you must run the hook installer again.
Until you do, Sentinel refuses every action and prints the installer command.

To update:

1. Update the marketplace:

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace upgrade sentinel-hooks
    ```

2. Run the hook installer from the new copy, as in install step 3.

3. Start Codex, open `/hooks`, and trust Sentinel's hooks.

To remove, remove the hooks first.
If you remove the plugin first, the hook entries name a missing copy, and Sentinel refuses every action until you delete the entries from your hook file.

1. Remove Sentinel's hooks from your hook file. The installer keeps every other hook.

    ```sh
    ~/.codex/plugins/cache/sentinel-hooks/sentinel/*/harnesses/codex/install-hooks.py --uninstall
    ```

2. Start Codex, open `/plugins`, and remove Sentinel.

3. Remove the marketplace:

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace remove sentinel-hooks
    ```

## GitHub Copilot CLI

To install, run:

```sh
copilot plugin marketplace add ahgraber/sentinel-hooks
copilot plugin install sentinel@sentinel-hooks
```

Then start a new session.

To update, run `copilot plugin update sentinel`.

To remove, run `copilot plugin uninstall sentinel`.

## GitHub Copilot in VS Code

To install:

1. Open the Agent Customizations editor and select **Browse**.
2. Open the source menu and select **Configure Marketplaces**.
3. Select **Add Marketplace** and enter `ahgraber/sentinel-hooks`.
4. Return to **Browse**, select the `sentinel-hooks` marketplace, and install Sentinel.

Then start a new chat session.

To update, open the Agent Customizations editor, select **Configure Marketplaces**, select `sentinel-hooks`, and choose **Refresh Marketplace**.

To remove, select **Plugins** in the Agent Customizations editor, open Sentinel's details, and select **Uninstall**.

## Pi

To install, run:

```sh
pi install git:github.com/ahgraber/sentinel-hooks
```

Pi installs the whole repository and loads Sentinel as an extension.
Run `pi list` to see the package.

To update, run `pi update git:github.com/ahgraber/sentinel-hooks`.

To remove, run `pi remove git:github.com/ahgraber/sentinel-hooks`.

## Confirm that Sentinel runs

In a new session, ask the agent to run this command:

```sh
sudo -n true
```

Sentinel refuses it, and the agent shows the message `Blocked: privilege escalation detected.`
If the command runs, or fails only because `sudo` needs a password, Sentinel is not running in that agent.
Read the [session-start report](session-start-report.qmd) to find the cause.
